reviews.text: Good vets  was friendly and caring . Answered my questions with no trouble . Lovely pratice
I visited for my kitten vaccination and flea treatment and found it really wonderful, staff is so cooperative and clinic is well maintained well trained staff .. highly recommend

Really helpful and responsive service. Rima was very kind and efficient, and helped me arrange everything quickly and clearly. She made the whole booking process really easy. Thank you to Rima and the team at Woodwharf Vet!

We cannot recommend Wood Wharf Vets enough! We moved to the area recently and had two checkup and vaccination visits for our cat Moon… from the receptionist to the veterinary team, they are welcoming and efficient; the facility is very clean too. We love it!

Special mention to Katerina the vet: very professional, caring, and gentle… even clipping his nails…
Very professional bunch. Many thanks.

Avoid this practice if you want your pet alive.

I called in this morning regarding a cat who has difficulty breathing and was in clear distress. The receptionist asked some very basic questions (“is the cat breathing?” “Is the cat’s gums pale?” “Are there any other symptoms?” “Are there any chemicals around the house?”). I explained the cat is struggling to breathe, is panting and his mouth is open. The receptionist told me “panting is nothing to worry about if there’s no other symptoms, he is fine - entirely up to you to bring him or not, we only have appointments later in the day”. Clearly the situation was an emergency and needed to take the cat to a different practice. The cat ended up needing CPR and has a life threatening condition which Wood Wharf Vets have dismissed.

I will be submitting a case to the appropriate regulators because this is clear negligence.

Was given an appointment within two hours as my dog had a potentially infected paw.
Right from arriving, we were seen very promptly by May, the vet. Not only did Coral the nurse check us in, she had to hold my dog who who clearly trying to avoid the whole thing.
They were very gentle and soothing in word and tone to him.
We got given clear advice and medication as to what to do next. Sergio the receptionist also was kind enough to offer water.
Thank you all from the two of us. Great service.🐶

We’ve had a fantastic experience with Wood Wharf Vets. From the moment we walked in, Liberty on reception was welcoming, friendly and made everything feel easy. Louie was brilliant with our pet – professional, knowledgeable and genuinely caring. He took the time to explain everything clearly and made us feel completely at ease. It’s obvious the whole team really cares about the animals they look after. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend Wood Wharf Vets to anyone looking for excellent veterinary care.
Very nice clinic. They took a great care of my cat
I’ve been taking my cat to this vet a few times now, always good!

Really happy with this vet. Our Shiba is a nervous wreck at appointments, but the vets here are consistently calm and gentle with him — never rushed, always reassuring. Bonus points for one of the easiest online booking systems I've used. Would absolutely recommend
Horrible customer service. Booking the appointment for one time and the wait is more than 30 minutes without any information. Not taking care properly of animals as well. Don’t recommend at all.

Don’t go here. My mini dachshund went in today and they cut her nails too short and they were bleeding (which has never happened in any other groom before). Also my dog was not picked up / handled properly. Won’t be going back
They are great and have always managed to see my lovely girl in urgent situations.
Very helpful

We had a great experience at Wood Wharf Vets with our dog Tokyo. Every time we needed them, they saw her promptly and took excellent care of her.

We’re especially grateful to Dr. Anna Ducos and Dr. Bernard for always being so thorough and kind with Tokyo, which gave us real peace of mind.

The team has also been very helpful with our insurance claims and always responsive whenever we needed follow-ups.

I am speaking on behalf of my cat - James Bond.

Today, my best friend, aka my mom brought me to Vets Wood Wharf for my second annual health checkup and vaccination. As I am a little timid boii, I was very nervous when we walked into the clinic. However, we were greeted by a very nice receptionist, who told me that she liked my name! (my name is bond, james bond, btw).

Around a minute later, we were welcomed into the consultation room by Doctor Jae, a very incredibly nice and bubbly vet who quickly calmed me down. She did a thorough checkup on me - eyes, dental, heart beat, intestines, you name it, and praised that I am in very good shape (ofc i am! I’m James Bond and i do zoomies 24/7!!!) Lastly, she jammed me in my leg. But she was sooo gentle I barely feel a thing! She did informed my hooman that I would be quite tired after the jab though, so here I am, gonna go back to napping again.

Thank you so much Doctor Jae for seeing me and the team for greeting us. We’d highly recommend Vets Wood Wharf to anyone in the Canary Wharf area!

I recently visited and was consulted by a lovely French vet Anna who, despite being extremely busy, managed to see my cat on such short notice. She had such a caring approach to handling them and carrying out their general check up. She was very knowledgeable and had a magical way with both of them and me as a worried owner - using humor and professionalism to make me feel at ease. I could see that the vets are under enormous pressure and despite lacking AC in the consulting rooms, she managed to keep calm and professional. The vets here really care about the animals and treat them as if they are their own. Although pet care is not cheap, this is clearly driven by the practice, not the vets who only want the best care for the animals. The bad reviews I have seen on here seem to lack any empathy of veterinary practice and are not a fair reflection of the quality of care that I have experienced from Dr Anna and her team.

Disappointing experience and questionable professionalism. You can probably trust them with basic things like deworming and general check-ups, but for anything serious like blood tests, scans, or surgery—it’s best to go elsewhere.

1. When taking a blood sample from my cat, the vet left her leg bruised and red, and still said the sample wasn’t sufficient.

2. Almost every check has required oral sedatives (gabapentin)—and in doses that appeared far above the standard recommendation for my pet‘s weight. These together reflect a lack of proper handling skills, causing unnecessary stress and risk to the pets.

3. What’s more frustrating is that inconclusive results led to repeated tests, doubling the cost without clear progress or answers. I’ve already been quite flexible with the budget, but I feel that the traumatic experience for my pet and the ineffective and costly examinations are the biggest red flags.

My advice: Run! don’t choose this clinic! I did see some negative reviews before registering, but I chose it because it was close by. A more competent hospital might save your pet a lot of distress—and save you time and money in the long run.
Lola is a regular here, as well as Poplar Vets. And has been for the last 7 years.
They never answer their phone so pissed off with them as Ive tried to book an emergency appointment on 2 occassions
Amazing services! Highly recommended 5 stars all of them 🥳 …

Wonderful and understanding vets. Very accessible as you can WhatsApp them for fast replies and booking appointments with ease. For our last appointment with our cat, we were in there for an hour - so you’re definitely getting your moneys worth. The receptionists are kind and easy to talk to.

Went to the vets to register my pets, was told to go away and register online, so went to do this to be greeted by this childish attempt at a form - gave me a dodgy impression of the place, then I read the reviews! Should probably just shut this place down.

Horrible experience. Sent my dog when she started limping. She was given pain killers and sedatives. My dog collapsed 2 days later, obviously as a side effect of the medication. They dismissed it as BOA crisis. She never had BOA crisis and never collapsed until she took the medications. She started salivating excessively and even called emergency that same evening.

The worst part, my insurance company emailed them to verify medical records. They keep on saying they haven’t received it, although I can clearly see them. We’re both on Gmail. After sending a follow up, they keep on hanging up on me.

My experience: Dishonest practice which adds hidden fees

I went mid-July with my cat that wasn't eating properly, a month and a week after my first appointment at their other practice in Poplar (for an unrelated eye issue). Before the examination started and at every step of the appointment, I asked clearly that I wanted to be aware and agree on all treatments performed, as I knew I couldn't afford blindly all fees. The vet listened and gave me a price at every step, trying to make me agree on a package of examinations instead of doing them one by one. After a small discussion, they agreed to perform a blood test first (120£), before doing an echography (90£), and I declined hospitalisation because of the huge price (300£). The blood test was enough to discover the issue right away, that my cat had kidney failure (note that the other vet in Poplar told me my cat had GREAT kidneys). The vet told me my cat would probably not live more than a month and gave me medication to try to improve the health of my cat for the remaining time.
After almost 3 hours, I went to pay they made me pay before sending me the invoice. With the shock of the news, I paid and went home to spend the remaining time with my cat.

I then looked at the invoice, and they added 70£ of random additional fees, which I suppose were performed but without me being informed: sample taking (do you seriously need to make people pay on top of the blood test??), IV fluids (never mentioned by the vet) and blood pressure (30£, seriously?). I reached out to the practice 3 weeks ago, and the manager of the practice was informed. He has been ignoring all contacts since then and they don't want to provide a feedback, apology or refund.
With the circumstances of pet owners going to the vet, and with the manager ignoring these requests, I can only believe they are dishonest and take advantage of their customers to charge them more than said. I'm greatly disappointed in the way they performed the examination, did a mistake without apologies at the other practice and charged more.

Note that the receptionist and vet are nice and understanding, but if they rip-off their customers, maybe they are not that much.

We went for an ear problem. 3 appointments and 2 months later, we're no closer to a diagnosis or treatment. We were finally given a referral to a specialist, but to out surprise the specialist is located outside the M25.
Bought the kitten bundle which included; vaccinations, microchipping, x4 tablets of worm treatment, 6x300g of cat food and the flea treatment. …
